purpose: Token-friendly index of rules that apply before editing external/live projects linked from the workbench.

project_overlays.notes: No separate top-level source rules file was found during setup.
Existing source-side CodeRules.txt must be treated as a project-specific overlay.

priority_order: explicit user request for the current task
compact_rules: Verify project context before writing code.
Fail fast; do not hide errors, suppress exceptions, or invent defaults.
Preserve existing gameplay outcomes unless the user explicitly requests a mechanic change.
Reuse existing systems and follow the project's architecture.
No god classes; enforce SRP and one C# class per file.
Assume high load and avoid hidden hot-path costs.
Verify Unity dependency ownership, lifecycle, and editor wiring before changing dependencies.
Use direct Unity YAML edits only when narrow, inspectable, and safe; otherwise provide Editor steps.
After external edits, refresh workbench indexes, Unity context when relevant, and change records.
